name: Hainan Mining Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating within China, Hainan Mining Co., Ltd. specializes in the extraction, processing, reclamation, and sale of iron ore. The company primarily furnishes steel manufacturers with its key products, which include lump ore, fine ore, and iron ore concentrate. Formerly recognized as Hainan Mining United Co., Ltd., the firm officially adopted its present name, Hainan Mining Co., Ltd., in August 2009. Established in 2007, its corporate headquarters are located in Shilu, China.
